30: ##################################################
31: # Project expected outcomes of pan-cancer testing
32: # at age-specific screening occasions:
33: # 1. expected exposed to unnecessary confirmation (EUCs)
34: # 2. expected cancers detected (CDs)
35: # 3. expected lives saved (LSs)
36: ##################################################
37: library(tidyverse)
38: library(scales)
39: library(viridis)
40: 
41: datestamp <- '2021-05-15'
42: 
43: ##################################################
44: # Control paths
45: ##################################################
46: basepath <- '..'
47: datapath <- file.path(basepath, 'data')
48: resupath <- file.path(basepath, 'results')
49: 
50: ##################################################
51: # Project outcomes for k-cancer test
52: #
53: # Notation in paper         Variable name
54: # ---------------------------------------
55: # P_A                       prevalence (of A)
56: # P_A(T+)                   sensitivity (of A)
57: # L_A(T+)                   localization (of A)
58: # Sp                        specificity
59: # m_A                       mortality (of A)
60: # R_A                       mortality reduction (of A)
61: ##################################################
62: k_cancer_test <- function(dset, specificity=0.99, size=1000){
63:     # group results by cancer site
64:     gset <- dset %>% group_by(site)
65:     # expected exposed to unnecessary confirmation
66:     tset <- gset %>% summarize(prevs=value[feature == 'prevalence'],
67:                                tests=value[feature == 'prevalence']*
68:                                      value[feature == 'sensitivity'] *
69:                                      (1-value[feature == 'localization']))
70:     tests <- with(tset, size*(sum(tests)+(1-specificity)*(1-sum(prevs))))
71:     # expected cancers detected
72:     iset <- gset %>% summarize(cancers=value[feature == 'prevalence']*
73:                                        value[feature == 'sensitivity']*
74:                                        value[feature == 'localization'])
75:     cancers <- with(iset, size*sum(cancers))
76:     # expected lives saved
77:     lset <- gset %>% summarize(lives=value[feature == 'effect']*
78:                                      value[feature == 'sensitivity']*
79:                                      value[feature == 'localization']*
80:                                      value[feature == 'mortality'])
81:     lives <- with(lset, size*sum(lives))
82:     tibble(EUC=tests, CD=cancers, LS=lives)
83: }
84: 
85: ##################################################
86: # Pan-cancer test for two hypothetical cancers
87: # across selected scenarios:
88: # 1. varying sensitivity of both cancers=0.5 to 0.9
89: # 2. fixed prevalence of cancer A=0.001
90: # 3. varying prevalence of cancer B=0 to 0.01
91: # 4. varying localization of both cancers=0.5 to 0.8
92: # 5. varying specificity=0.95 to 0.99
93: ##################################################
94: hypothetical_test <- function(specificity, localization.a=c(0.5, 0.8)){
95:     dset <- expand_grid(prevalence.a=0.005,
96:                         prevalence.b=c(0, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02),
97:                         sensitivity.a=seq(0.5, 0.9, by=0.1),
98:                         localization.a=localization.a,
99:                         mortality.a=0)
100:     dset <- dset %>% mutate(scenario=seq(nrow(dset)),
101:                             sensitivity=sensitivity.a,
102:                             localization=localization.a,
103:                             prevalence=prevalence.b,
104:                             sensitivity.b=sensitivity.a,
105:                             localization.b=localization.a,
106:                             mortality.b=mortality.a)
107:     dset <- dset %>% pivot_longer(-c(scenario,
108:                                      sensitivity,
109:                                      localization,
110:                                      prevalence),
111:                                   names_to=c('feature', 'site'),
112:                                   names_pattern='(.*)[.]([ab])',
113:                                   values_to='value')
114:     dset <- dset %>% mutate(specificity=specificity)
115:     dset <- dset %>% group_by(scenario,
116:                               sensitivity,
117:                               localization,
118:                               specificity,
119:                               prevalence)
120:     dset <- dset %>% do(k_cancer_test(., specificity=specificity))
121:     dset <- dset %>% ungroup()
122: }

159:                                   names_to='feature',

162:     dset <- dset %>% do(k_cancer_test(., specificity=specificity))
